_purpose: Canonical output of the physical-truth convergence layer. Produced by the convergence engine after evaluating all admitted witness evidence. This object is the input to the LNES-22 action-authority layer. RELEASE_ELIGIBLE is NOT a raw sensor state — it is a derived engineering result produced by this convergence process.

predicate.description: Physical claim that was evaluated (e.g. tether.elongation, motor.identity).

configuration_epoch.description: Configuration epoch against which this state was resolved.

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing version of this state object for this aircraft/component. Incremented on each resolution.

resolved_at.description: UTC timestamp of the convergence evaluation.

documentary_state_ref.description: Reference ID of the documentary record(s) evaluated. Null if no documentary evidence contributed.

command_state_ref.description: Reference ID of the command/configuration state record evaluated.

witness_refs.description: All witness packet IDs considered (admitted + rejected).

admitted_witness_refs.description: Witness packet IDs that passed all four admissibility checks and were used in convergence.

rejected_witness_refs.description: Witness packet IDs that failed one or more admissibility checks. Each listed in reason_codes.

resolution_state.description: Operational truth state. These nine states are the exhaustive output of convergence. RELEASE_ELIGIBLE and HOLD are derived release decisions, not resolution states.

release_decision.description: Engineering release authorization derived from resolution_state by release_policy.py. RELEASE_ELIGIBLE means: all evidence is consistent and sufficient for engineering clearance. HOLD means: a safety-relevant issue prevents clearance. INCOMPLETE means: insufficient evidence to decide.

reason_codes.description: Human-readable reason strings explaining non-VERIFIED_MATCH or non-RELEASE_ELIGIBLE decisions. Also documents why witnesses were rejected.

known_conflicts.description: DOCUMENT_PHYSICAL_CONFLICT or SENSOR_CONFLICT entries, preserved as non-collapsing state. Each identifies the pair of conflicting evidence sources.

known_damage.description: Historical documentary damage records. Preserved even when current physical readings are GOOD. Never mutated by a physical-state conflict.

sensor_health_summary.description: Per-sensor health flags from admitted witnesses.

witness_trust_summary.description: Per-witness admissibility verdict and failed trust properties if any.

provenance_root.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of all admitted evidence contributing to this state. Enables external verification that the state was derived from specific evidence.

previous_state_root.description: provenance_root of the immediately preceding state version for this aircraft/component. Null for the first state version. Enables audit of state transitions.

_historical_truth_preservation: The known_damage array is append-only. A physical-state conflict (DOCUMENT_PHYSICAL_CONFLICT) never erases or mutates a historical documentary record. The current resolution_state and release_decision represent the current engineering conclusion; the historical documentary facts remain independently accessible.
_release_eligible_is_not_a_sensor_state: RELEASE_ELIGIBLE appears only in release_decision, never in resolution_state. It is a derived policy output, not a measurement.
